schema.text: Which best describes using this place on foot?

options.text: I can pass without slowing down
I need to slow down a little
I need to be careful while passing
It takes a lot of effort or attention
I avoid using it if possible
I cannot get through (for example with a wheelchair or stroller)

en.#It takes a lot of effort or attention: It takes a lot of effort or attention
en.#I avoid using it if possible: I avoid using it if possible
en.#I cannot get through (for example with: I cannot get through (for example with a wheelchair or stroller)

it.#Which best describes using this place o: Quale frase descrive meglio la tua esperienza a piedi in questo luogo?
it.#It takes a lot of effort or attention: Mi costa molta fatica o molta attenzione

fr.#Which best describes using this place o: Quelle phrase décrit le mieux votre expérience à pied dans ce lieu ?
fr.#I need to be careful while passing: Je dois faire attention en passant
fr.#It takes a lot of effort or attention: Cela me demande beaucoup d'effort ou d'attention
